document: Instruction issued to a sports team manager by an organising body
glossary: Document type: Instruction issued to a sports team manager by an organising body. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.document_title: the document title as printed on the document
field_specs.issuing_body: the issuing body as printed on the document
field_specs.recipient: the recipient as printed on the document
field_specs.date: the date as printed on the document
field_specs.subject: the subject as printed on the document
